11	### ⚙️ Options

16	|`--app` `<app-id\|app-name>`|Application to manage by its ID (or name, if unambiguous)|
17	|`-c`, `--command` `<command>`|Execute a command on the remote instance and exit|

19	|`--instance` `<instance-id>`|Instance ID to connect to (skips interactive selection)|

I couldn't edit `src/commands/ssh/ssh.command.js` because write permission was denied, so nothing has changed yet. Please grant write access, or tell me if you'd rather apply the change yourself.

This is what I planned for `--instance` in `clever ssh`:

- **`any`:** connects to the first instance in the list, sorted by instance number.
- **A number such as `2`:** connects to the instance with that `instanceNumber`, the same number the interactive list shows as "Instance N".
- **Anything else:** still treated as an instance ID, so existing usage keeps working.
- **No match:** it fails with the existing "is not a running instance" error.
- **Help text:** the description would change to "Instance to connect to: its ID, its number in the list, or "any" (skips interactive selection)". The placeholder would become `instance`.

Once the edit is in, I'll run `npm run docs` to regenerate `ssh.docs.md`, then `npm run validate`.
